native.sd_edition: Actual selected audited discovery edition versus independently qualified alternative.
native.sd_proposal_mode: Actual deployment configuration versus explicitly selected standard proposals.
native.sd_transport: Discovery itself is UDP, independent from advertised TCP/UDP service endpoints.
native.sd_ip_version: Actual SD message IPv4 or IPv6 binding; SD endpoint option must match sender path.
native.sd_role: Actual sender or receiver; undefined flags/empty option runs have distinct sending versus receiving rules.
native.sd_relation: Actual unicast per peer versus multicast relation; counters kept independently.
native.sd_byte_order: All discovery fields are network byte order, distinct service payload serialization.
native.sd_entry: Actual entry action; shared wire types are distinguished by TTL.
native.sd_option: Selected decoded option, independently from all options in the complete array.
native.sd_endpoint_transport: Actual advertised service TCP/UDP versus discovery UDP; multicast endpoint uses UDP.
native.sd_phase: Actual per-service DOWN/INITIAL_WAIT/REPETITION/MAIN state, not global CAN cycle.
native.sd_retry_kind: Configured finite retries versus until reboot/request cancellation under forever offer.
native.sd_event_delivery: Actual chosen client-provided endpoint or server multicast endpoint, not SD message relation.
native.sd_outcome: Actual discovery/application subscription outcome; a parsed ACK can still fail resources/security checks.
native.sd_port: Actual UDP discovery port, source default30490; not advertised application endpoint port.
native.sd_header_service_id: Wire SOME/IP SD service0xFFFF, distinct service ID in entries.
native.sd_header_method_id: Wire SOME/IP SD method0x8100, not ordinary event ID.
native.sd_interface_version: Wire SD interface version1, distinct entry major version.
native.sd_message_type: Wire discovery notification0x02 only, no TP flag.
native.sd_return_code: Wire discovery return code0, not application acceptance result.
native.sd_client_id: Wire discovery client0, single SD instance.
native.sd_session_id: Actual per-relation session1..65535, increment per sent message and wrap to1.
native.sd_old_session_id: Last received session on this same source/destination relation, not another peer.
native.sd_undefined_flags: Actual low six undefined flag bits, sender0 and receiver ignores.
native.sd_reserved24: Actual24-bit reserved header field; no guessed device value.
native.sd_entry_type: Actual wire entry type0/1/6/7; TTL separates stopping/NACK from positive state.
native.sd_service_id: Actual offered/found service, wildcard0xFFFF for Find;0xFFFE distinct non-SOME/IP service.
native.sd_instance_id: Actual service instance, wildcard0xFFFF allowed Find only; zero reserved.
native.sd_major: Actual entry service major version, Find wildcard0xFF; not SD header interface1.
native.sd_minor: Actual service minor version, Find wildcard0xFFFFFFFF.
native.sd_ttl_s: Actual24-bit lifetime in seconds,0 stop/NACK;0xFFFFFF means until reboot; Find ignores this field.
native.sd_eventgroup_id: Actual eventgroup,zero reserved and0xFFFF all groups special selection.
native.sd_counter: Actual4-bit subscription differentiator; zero when counter unused.
native.sd_expected_service_id: Actual outstanding Subscribe service ID copied into ACK/NACK.
native.sd_expected_instance_id: Actual outstanding Subscribe instance ID copied into ACK/NACK.
native.sd_expected_major: Actual outstanding Subscribe major interface version.
native.sd_expected_ttl_s: Actual outstanding Subscribe lifetime copied into ACK, not NACK zero.
native.sd_entries_count: Actual number of16-byte entries in full array, not device count.
native.sd_entries_bytes: Actual entries array bytes,16 times actual entries count.
native.sd_options_count: Actual number of variable-size options in full array.
native.sd_options_bytes: Actual full options array bytes, including every option length/type field.
native.sd_index1: First run starting option index, uint8; empty sender run requires zero.
native.sd_index2: Second run starting option index, uint8; empty receiver run ignores nonzero index.
native.sd_count1: First run option count,uint4,not full array bytes.
native.sd_payload_bytes: Actual SD body12+entries+options, excludes16-byte SOME/IP header.
native.sd_length_bytes: Actual SOME/IP length20+entries+options, starts at request ID.
native.sd_message_bytes: Actual complete UDP SOME/IP SD message28+entries+options.
native.sd_udp_budget_bytes: Actual qualified datagram/IP/security/path budget; not fixed1400 or Ethernet1500 app cap.
native.sd_option_type: Actual raw option type code, distinct decoded selected kind.
native.sd_option_length: Actual option length excludes two-byte length and one-byte type; endpoint9/21, load5.
native.sd_option_index: Actual position of this option in full array, SD endpoint must be first.
native.sd_option_flags_reserved: Actual7-bit reserved option flags, sender zero.
native.sd_option_reserved8: Actual endpoint reserved byte, zero on sending.
native.sd_endpoint_port: Actual advertised service/discovery endpoint port; zero invalid.
native.sd_endpoint_protocol: Actual IANA L4 code6 TCP or17 UDP; multicast/SD UDP17 only.
native.sd_priority: Load balancing priority lower means preferred; only applies all-instance searches.
native.sd_weight: Actual load balancing weight for equal-priority candidates; no universal default.
native.sd_configuration_sequence_bytes: Actual single DNS-TXT-style key/value sequence length,uint8 excluding length byte.
native.sd_endpoint_references: Actual entry references to service endpoint options, not SD identification option.
native.sd_multicast_references: Actual entry references to multicast event options.
native.sd_configuration_references: Actual configuration-option references permitted per entry.
native.sd_load_references: Actual load balancing option references, only offers.
native.sd_sd_endpoint_count: Actual number of SD identification endpoint options, at most one per selected message family.
native.sd_repetitions_max: Configured number of repetition steps; zero skips phase, no universal default2.
native.sd_retry_max: Actual finite max subscription retries,zero=no retry; no universal default.
native.sd_retry_count: Actual completed retries for current eventgroup request.
native.sd_multicast_threshold: Configured clients with distinct endpoints switching threshold;0/1 have special policies.
native.sd_subscribed_endpoints: Actual distinct subscribed endpoints, not count of all duplicate subscriptions.
native.sd_initial_min_ms: Configured initial random delay minimum; protocol gives no universal value.
native.sd_initial_max_ms: Configured initial random delay maximum, at least minimum.
native.sd_initial_actual_ms: Actual chosen random delay within configured range.
native.sd_repetitions_base_ms: Configured base delay for doubling repetition steps, no default100ms from example.
native.sd_response_min_ms: Configured random response delay minimum for responses to multicast triggers.
native.sd_response_actual_ms: Actual response random delay; unicast response does not apply this delay.
native.sd_cyclic_offer_ms: Actual configured interval between offers in main phase, not generic CAN cycle.
native.sd_retry_delay_ms: Actual delay before missing-ACK/NACK subscription retry.
native.sd_elapsed_lifetime_s: Actual elapsed since received offer/subscription under same correlated state.
native.sd_source_bound_ms: Actual discovery generation/application request production bound.
native.sd_e2e_bound_ms: Actual discovery source+network+consumer chain, distinct service data path.
native.sd_age_ms: Actual discovery-state age at consuming application.
native.sd_reboot: Actual current relation reboot flag, true until first session wrap after boot.
native.sd_old_reboot: Last received reboot flag on the same source/destination relation.
native.sd_reboot_detected: Actual comparison result, not inferred from arbitrary lower session from another peer.
native.sd_wrapped_since_boot: Actual sender has completed first session wrap since boot.
native.sd_relation_initial: Actual first relation message without earlier receiver state.
native.sd_unicast_flag: Wire support for receiving unicast,1 for allSD messages even multicast relation.
native.sd_counter_used: Actual subscription counter differentiation configured; unused wire counter0.
native.sd_option_discardable: Unknown option can be ignored when discardable, distinct from required endpoint validity.
native.sd_option_referenced: Selected option is referenced by an entry; SD identification endpoint must not be.
native.sd_endpoint_valid: Actual address family/unicast-multicast/port/path verified under independent IP model.
native.sd_service_matches: Actual entry tuple/service-major binding matched, with only applicable wildcard rules.
native.sd_options_verified: Actual all options exist/types/lengths/conflicts/required references validated.
native.sd_security_required: Actual network security association required by service endpoint.
native.sd_security_ready: Actual required security association established and fully operational.
native.sd_tcp_required: Actual subscribed eventgroup requires already-open TCP connection.
native.sd_tcp_ready: Actual required service TCP connection exists before subscription.
native.sd_data_accepted: Actual independent discovery/subscription consumer acceptance, not SD header E_OK.
native.sd_binding_source: Actual canonical source/destination/peer/IP/port/channel and independent lower-layer bindings.
native.sd_service_source: Actual deployed service/instance/version/eventgroup and endpoint assignments.
native.sd_state_source: Actual correlated per-relation counters/reboot/phase/lifetime state definition.
native.sd_timing_source: Actual timers/route/resource budgets, independent from service functional timing.
native.sd_endpoint_address: Actual configured option endpoint address; independently qualified IP family and role, no guessed address.
native.sd_multicast_address: Actual configured SD multicast address, no universal vendor239-address default.
native.payload_bytes: Actual SD serialized body12+16-byte entries+full options array, distinct16-byte SOME/IP header and qualified UDP/IP/PHY/security datagram budget. No8-byte application default or1400-byte universal limit.
